content.code: --- description: "Generate focused tests" mode: "agent" tools: ["read", "search", "edit", "execute"] --- Find the smallest behavior that needs test coverage. Before editing: - Identify existing test conventions. - Name the file where tests should live. - State the missing behavior. Then add focused tests and run the relevant test command. # Cierre operativo done_when: evidencia + coste + owner stop_rule: parar si no hay senal nueva
